answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can charge a stake that works like a garden: every identity plants a small refundable deposit that only grows back after sustained honest work. An attacker cloning accounts faces a shale-like cost, each fake needs its own stake, and a knoll of many cheap fakes still cannot outbid one proven reputation. Flooding the market with a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes, so mass fakery stops paying.
